maml:description.maml:para: Generates cryptographically secure keys, passwords and secrets.

Produces secrets from the system CSPRNG (), never from . In the default password mode a character pool (letters, digits and symbols, or a custom set) is sampled uniformly, with optional -Min* parameters that guarantee character class coverage without weakening randomness: required characters are drawn from the intersection of the pool and the class, the remainder is filled from the whole pool, and the buffer is then shuffled with a CSPRNG-driven Fisher-Yates pass so the guaranteed characters do not land at predictable positions. Use -Encoding to switch to raw key material instead, sized in bytes and returned as Base64, Base64Url or hex. Use -AsSecureString or -AsCredential to avoid returning the secret as a plain string.
Aliases: nsk
